package.name: gz_thruster
package.description:
Gazebo's Thruster system with a normalized command interface, so an autopilot or a custom controller can command a fraction of full thrust rather than a force in newtons. Real thrusters are commanded that way - ArduPilot scales every output to a normalized range and PX4 to a duty cycle - and the stock plugin accepts only newtons or angular velocity.
Vendored from gz-sim and intended to go back upstream, so the delta is kept small and additive; see PROVENANCE.md.
